question: The length of a Beach Volleyball court is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**16 m.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The length of a Beach Volleyball court is** 16 m.**
 
• The required beach volleyball court dimensions for USA Volleyball and NCAA Beach Volleyball doubles competition is** 16m by 8m (52’6” by 26’3”).**
 
• Posts should be placed **1m (3’-4”) from each sideline, 10m (30’-7”) from each other(not shown).**
 
• Adjacent beach volleyball courts built side by side are recommended to have a free space of **5-6m (16’-20’) and may share free space.**
 
• If adjacent courts are situated **end line to end line, 9m (29’-6”) of free space is recommended.**
 
• Each team consists of six players.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Beach volleyball** made its debut at the** 1996 Atlanta Games.**
 
• The first team to win the Gold Medal was the** United States of America in 1996.**
 
• In 2016 Brazil won the **Gold Medal.**
 
• It is played on a Sand Court divided by the net.
 
• It was first played in **1915 **at the Outrigger Canoe Club, in Waikiki, Hawaii.
 
• Its international governing body is the **Federation Internationale de Volleyball (FIVB).**
